High school language arts asks you to do three things at a higher level than before: read texts closely and explain *how* they create meaning, build persuasive arguments, and write with precise, correct mechanics.

### Units

1. [Close Reading & Literary Analysis](close-reading.qmd) — theme, tone, and analyzing how literary devices create meaning
2. [Rhetoric & Argumentative Writing](rhetoric-argument.qmd) — ethos/pathos/logos, building a thesis-driven argument
3. [Grammar & Mechanics](grammar-mechanics.qmd) — clauses, common errors, and punctuation rules that trip people up

::: {.callout-note}
Later units (research writing, vocabulary/etymology, specific texts) can follow this same page structure.
:::
